## Verification

- [ ] Focused automated tests added or updated where behavior changed
- [ ] Relevant lint, type-check, build, or end-to-end checks ran
- [ ] UI changes checked at desktop and narrow mobile width where applicable

## KIO review

Before requesting `kiodreambau` as reviewer, select exactly one GitHub label:

- `kio:1` basic high-confidence review
- `kio:2` plus test-density review
- `kio:3` plus stability review
- `kio:4` four independent passes: correctness/accessibility, tests, stability, performance

KIO reacts only to the reviewer request. Normal PR comments and review-thread replies never start a run.
